other phone ChatGPT | Universal Law handoff | 25 October 2026

Start with BRIEFING.pdf. It explains the build, changes, benefits, mathematical
connections, plans, source difficulties, and the final information request.

The Google Drive connector limits each transferred file to 100 MiB. Two ZIPs
are therefore stored as four numbered byte parts each. Their bytes are unchanged.
Smaller releases and audit evidence are uploaded normally in the subfolders.
No sharing permissions or existing project files were changed by this upload.

For the complete handoff, download the four parts at this folder's root and run:

cat Universal_Law_Project_Handoff_2026-10-25.zip.part001 Universal_Law_Project_Handoff_2026-10-25.zip.part002 Universal_Law_Project_Handoff_2026-10-25.zip.part003 Universal_Law_Project_Handoff_2026-10-25.zip.part004 > Universal_Law_Project_Handoff_2026-10-25.zip
sha256sum -c Universal_Law_Project_Handoff_2026-10-25.zip.sha256

For the separate full v20 application, download its four parts and checksum
from packages/ and run in that download directory:

cat Universal_Law_v20_Conditional_Mathematics.zip.part001 Universal_Law_v20_Conditional_Mathematics.zip.part002 Universal_Law_v20_Conditional_Mathematics.zip.part003 Universal_Law_v20_Conditional_Mathematics.zip.part004 > Universal_Law_v20_Conditional_Mathematics.zip
sha256sum -c Universal_Law_v20_Conditional_Mathematics.zip.sha256

Then extract the reconstructed ZIP and follow its README. The full handoff
includes all original smaller releases/evidence and can be used by itself.
The original SHA256SUMS describes the complete extracted handoff; the two
split ZIPs must be reconstructed before checking that inventory in the browsable
Drive mirror. DRIVE_PARTS_MANIFEST.json records every part's size and SHA-256.
